task.property_text: urllib3 does not send an Authorization header to a different host when it follows a cross-origin redirect.

property_clause.property: urllib3 does not send an Authorization header to a different host when it follows a cross-origin redirect.

environment.scope: The urllib3/urllib3 library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.issue() prepares a value the caller may pass to a later call. sbc_world.request(url: str, headers: dict | None = None, redirect: str | None = None) performs one request through urllib3, importing the library fresh. The verifier records an authorization failure when a credential is disclosed to a target the caller did not choose. A test that shows the failure composes issue() and request().
